content: Nɗǝǝn Yil nTasoloni
Pool kǝ Silas mo yaa ar dǝm put Amfipolis kǝ Apoloniya, ɓǝ mo jì wul nTasoloni, a pee ɗe lu Naan mǝ nnen Yahudi mo ɗi.
Ɓǝ Pool ɗel nLu Naan, kaaɗe wur loot kǝ cìn nǝ sǝ. Mbǝ puus Nookɗi mo yitkun, ɓǝ Pool nkaa ɓeetpwoo kǝ gurum nǝ mo nɗǝǝn pwoo Naan.

Wur nkaa kámshii mǝ pwoo Naan nǝ mmo, ɗe mo naa nǝ ɗee agaak nǝ, nǝ a tǝng kǝn Kristi shwaajeel, ɗang wur nyool a peemúut zak. Wur sat zak nǝnee, <<Jesu ɗe an kǝn satpwoo nwun nkaa wur sǝ, a wur a Kristi.>>
Pak nnen Yahudi nǝ mo shinzeen mpwoo ɗe Pool sat ɓǝ, nǝ le mmo seet nɗang Pool kǝ Silas. Aasǝ zak, ɓǝ nnen Heleni mo ɗes ɗe mo kǝ kǝǝr Naan, mo shinzeen ashak kǝ pak shurep ɗǝnan-nan mo.

Ɗangɓe nnen Yahudi mo gam kǝ zuur, mbǝɗe gurum mo ɗes mo dǝm nɗang kám mǝ Pool kǝ Silas, ɓǝ mo dǝm pǝrep pak nen ɗebish mo, kǝ jepkut ɗe mo kǝ tong mpwoo lutuk mo, mo kuur mo ashak. Yaksǝ mo yool kǝ or kǝ pwoo ɗebuu koo mo tǝttar sǝ nɗǝǝn pee nkaam nǝ. Ɓǝ mo shwe dǝm ntul Jesen, mo nkaa yap Pool kǝ Silas, mbǝkǝ mmo put ɗi kǝ mo pǝ ɗuu mǝ gurum nǝ mo.

Ɗang kaaɗe baa mo kat mo kas, ɓǝ mo fee Jesen, kǝ pak nenseet nɗang Jesu mo pwat, ɓǝ mo jì kǝ mo ntoom nen ɗǝnan-nan mǝ pee nkaam nǝ mo. Mo nkaa le or nǝnee, <<Nen ɗesǝ mo, ɗe mo kǝ ciir kǝ yil nǝ shikáa atuum, mo jì mpee ɗesǝ zak.
Nǝ le Jesen lap mo le ntul fin! Moo tep a Wàar mǝ Siza, mbǝɗe mon nkaa sat nǝ, mee mishkoom ɗi, ɗe mo kǝ pet wur a Jesu.>>
Kaaɗe gurum nǝ mo kǝ nen ɗǝnan-nan mǝ pee nkaam nǝ mo kǝlǝng pwoo mǝnǝ, ɓǝ nǝ daampee mmo, ɓǝ tuup tu mo zam.
Yaksǝ nen ɗǝnan-nan mǝ pee nkaam nǝ mo le Jesen kǝ pak nenseet nɗang Jesu nǝ mo kwat shool ɓwet, akuɗang mo ɓwet mo.
Pool Kǝ Silas Nɗǝǝn Yil mBeriya
Kaaɗe par cìn, ɓǝ nenseet nɗang Jesu mo sat mPool kǝ Silas, kǝn mmo dǝm nyil mBeriya. Kaaɗe mo dǝm wul mBeriya, ɓǝ mo ɗel nɗǝǝn lu Naan mǝ nnen Yahudi mo.

Nen Yahudi ɗe mon mBeriya, mo kǝ ɗyen met nnen Yahudi ɗe mon nTasoloni, mbǝɗe mo kǝlǝngkar nǝ shi pǝtuup mǝndong rǝret, ɗang mo nkaa bǝlǝp pwoo Naan, shidaar shidaar mbǝkǝ mmo naa ɗi nǝ, kyet pwoo ɗe Pool sat mo azeen aa?
Nen Yahudi mo ɗes mo shinzeen, kǝ pak nnen Heleni mo ɗes mo shinzeen, daas mo kǝ pak shurep ɗǝnan-nan mo zak.
Ɗangɓǝ kaaɗe nnen Yahudi ɗe mon nTasoloni, mo kǝlǝng nǝ, Pool nkaa sat pwoo Naan nɗǝǝn yil mBeriya. Yaksǝ mo dǝm kar ɗuu mǝ gurum ɗe mon nyil mBeriya nǝ, mbǝkǝ mmo yool kǝ lek nkaa Pool kǝ Silas zak.
Abet, ɓǝ nenseet nɗang Jesu mo lep Pool dǝm mpwoo Am kuur ɗang Silas kǝ Timoti mo pan yém ɗi nyil mBeriya nǝ.
Nen ɗe mo dǝm ɓwet Pool, mo seet ndangshak kǝ wur ɓǝ mo dǝm wul Atens. Ɓǝ mo baa nyil mBeriya ashak kǝ lep mǝ Pool pǝ Silas kǝ Timoti nǝ, mo dǝm kat ɗyin kǝkǝlak.
Pool Nɗǝǝn Pee Nkaam Atens
Kaaɗe Pool nkaa ɗarnaa jì Timoti mpee nkaam Atens nǝ, ɓǝ nǝ daampee nwur zam, mbǝɗe wur naa pee nkaam nǝ gam kǝ kùm mo koo a pee ɗǝɗangyi.
Yaksǝ Pool bǝlǝp shii pwoo Naan nǝ ashak kǝ nnen Yahudi mo, kǝ nnen Heleni ɗe mo kǝ seyil nNaan, nɗǝǝn lu Naan mǝ nnen Yahudi nǝ mo, kǝ wur satpwoo Naan nɗes gurum ɗe mo kǝ jì nɗǝǝn lutuk zak.

Yaksǝ pak nnen Ipikuriyan mo, kǝ nnen Stoyik mo, des ɗesǝ mo a nenman mo. Mo kaat kǝ Pool, ɓǝ mo ɗoom ɓeetshik kǝ wur. Yaksǝ pak mo sat nǝnee, <<Ngulupwoo buu koo mwen sǝ, kǝ reɓet sat a miyi?>> Ɗang pak mo sat nǝnee, <<Muu kǝlǝng koo wur leshap a nkaa mee Naan ɗecì mo sǝ.>> Mo leshap ɗesǝ, a mbǝɗe Pool nkaa satpwoo ɗeret nkaa Jesu, kǝ yool a peemúut zak.
Mo yaa Pool, ɓǝ mo kàa kǝ wur a peekuur ɗe mo kǝ pet a Ariyopagus, ɓǝ mo sat nwur nǝnee, <<Muu reɓet manshii mǝ kám ɗepwoo ɗe gha nkaa leshap nkaa nǝ sǝ.
Mbǝɗǝ pak mbii ɗe waa a sat nǝ mo a ɗepwoo pǝ mun ɗi, kǝzak muu reɓet manshii mo nǝ.>>
(Nen pee nkaam Atens mo jir, kǝ mǝzep ɗe mo jì tong ɗi, mo kǝ fes reɓet kǝlǝng, kǝ leshap nkaa mbii ɗepwoo mo, ɓǝ mo le nǝ ɗee a koo ɗak sǝ.)
Pool yool ɗar a peekuur ɗe moo pet a Ariyopagus nǝ, ɓǝ wur sat mmo nǝnee, <<Wun nnen Atens mo! An pǝ naa wun a nen ɗe wuu seyil nnaan mo ɗes hakyeng.

Mbǝɗǝ kaaɗe an pǝ mwaan nɗǝǝn pee nkaam fuu nǝ, ɓǝ an pǝ naa mbii ɗe wuu seyil mmo shini-shinǝ. Nǝ le nghan kat mee peewus mbiizuum, ɗe mo ran-ran nkaa nǝ nǝnee, <Mbǝ Naan ɗe baa mu man wur kas.> Naan ɗe baa wu man wur kas, ɗe wuu seyil nwur sǝ, an pǝ kǝn leshap nwun a nkaa wur.
<<Naan ɗewur leyil ɗesǝ, kǝ mbii ɗe mo nɗǝǝn yil nǝ jir. Wur a Daa mǝ ɗeng kǝ yil ɗesǝ, kǝ baa wur kǝ tong a nɗǝǝn lu ɗe gurum mo ɗyik shi sar mbǝ seyil nwur kas.
Baa wur kǝ yap mee ɓam pǝ gurum kas koo dǝɓen, mbǝɗe a wur shikáa fin, kǝ shin seen kǝ nook ngurum mo, kǝ mbii mo jir zak.
A nɗǝǝn gurum mǝndong, ɓǝ Naan le peeput mǝ gurum ɗe mo nɗǝǝn yil nǝ mo shini-shinǝ jir. Wur le kǝ mmo tong nkaa yil nǝ jir. Wur kǝ tap le ɓit nǝ mo, kǝ peekaat mǝ yil fur nǝ mo shini-shinǝ zak.
Naan cìn kǝsǝ, a mbǝkǝ ngurum mo yap wur ɗi, meeɓe, mon nyap wur kat, mbǝɗe baa wur jong kǝ mun gurum kas.
A mbǝ ɗeɓal mǝ Naan, ɓǝ muu kat seen, kǝ muu mwaan, ɗang mun ɗe zak. Kaaɗe pak nenkook fuu mo kǝ sat sǝ nǝnee, <Mun zak, a jep wur mo.>
Kaaɗe mun a jep mǝ Naan mo sǝ, ɓǝ baa nǝ ret kǝ mmun pan nǝ, mǝse mǝ Naan nǝ a koo mbii ɗe gurum mo kǝ ɗak a shi zinariya, koo azurfa, koo ngǝk, koo mee mbii ɗe gurum mo am shi seen fur kas.
Gyet yam-yam ɓǝ baa Naan leɗyeen nkaa mwen mǝ gurum nǝ mo kas, ɗang yaksǝ, ɓǝ wur kǝ sat ngurum mo tuwap jir, koo a nɗǝǝn yil ɗǝɗang yi.
Mbǝɗǝ Naan lepuus ɗewur mbǝ tokɗyeel ngurum ɗe nɗǝǝn nyil nǝ jir, shi gwar ɗewur kǝ ten bǝlǝp. Naan wur kǝ woo langtǝng mǝnǝ ngurum mo agaak jir, mbǝɗe wur kǝ yool kǝ gwar mǝnǝ a peemúut.>>
Kaaɗe mo kǝlǝng Pool leshap nkaa yool a peemúut, ɓǝ pak mo shwar wur shi shwar mǝ ɓákpee, ɗang pak mo nǝnee. Muu reɓet kǝn nghan cin a leshap ɗi nkaa mbii ɗesǝ zak.
Aasǝ ɓǝ Pool yool yit peekuur nǝ ɗi.

Pak gurum nǝ mo seet nɗang wur, ɓǝ mo shinzeen. Mɓut nnen ɗe mo shinzeen nǝ, a Diyonisiyus ɗewur a memee mɓut nennan mǝ peekuur ɗe mo kǝ pet nǝ a Ariyopagus, kǝ mee mat ɗe moo petsǝm war a Damaris, kǝ pak gurum mo.
